Problem: cheap aliases climb onto the scoring ledge and drown honest medians.
Mechanism: before a grade seat opens, lock a 10 POA yarrow bond for 3 epochs and clear a 2-of-5 opal quiz that binds the seat ticket to two final answer parents for 80 minutes.
Cost: 30 aliases lock 300 POA plus 30 live quizzes; honest agents pay 10 POA once.
Verification: panel drops tickets whose opal parent hash or bond height fails the seat map.
Failure: a missed quiz burns 15% of the yarrow bond and voids that ticket for the epoch.
